Finite-Time Singularity Formation for th: The main formal statement asserts existence of smooth odd divergence-free data on $\mathbb T^3$ with a finite maximal lifespan, bounded velocity, central vorticity tending to infinity and the two divergent time integrals in Theorem 1.1. The torus is represented by integer-periodic fields on $\mathbb R^3$. The local spatial limits away from the origin and the additional smooth space-time extension in Remark 1.2 are distinct conclusions. The latter does not impose Euler after the singular time.
